summary: Per-entity placements being executed: a map from actor entity to its placement entry. Written by esv::placement::ExecutionSystem (ProcessPlacementRequests builds a local HashMap<EntityHandle, 0x78-byte entry>; ProcessPlacements walks keys/values of this 0x40 component), read by placement::ValidationSystem::GatherValidationRequests. Seen.py context: dialogues with several NPCs and scripted events; born with StateComponent, ValidationComponent and PlacementResultEvent.

fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: Storage of a variant: a 40-byte Transform target (the Toolkit's ProcessPlacementRequests default-initialises an identity transform here) or, when TargetKind == 1, an EntityHandle at +0 (Windows esv::placement::ExecutionSystem bg3.exe+0x2F06990 walks this component's keys (+0x20, size +0x2C) and values (+0x30) with stride 0x78: if entry+0x28 == 1 the entity at +0 is used, otherwise a static null default). Declared as raw dwords because the alternatives overlay each other. ProcessPlacementRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x2FD330) default-initialises a new value with an identity transform (+0xC = 1.0f quat w, +0x1C/+0x20/+0x24 = 1.0f scale) and then copies the 40-byte transform from the EntityPlacement. When byte +0x28 == 1, ProcessPlacements / GatherValidationRequests treat the first 8 bytes as an entity (IsEntityAlive(value)) - a variant of transform or entity target.

fields.name: TargetKind
fields.evidence: Byte +0x28 compared with 1 in ExecutionSystem::ProcessPlacements (EoCServer.dll+0x2FDDD0) and ValidationSystem::GatherValidationRequests before using +0 as an entity; zeroed on creation. Probably the variant index. Windows: Windows esv::placement::ExecutionSystem bg3.exe+0x2F06990 walks this component's keys (+0x20, size +0x2C) and values (+0x30) with stride 0x78: entry+0x28 compared with 1 before using +0 as an entity.

fields.name: _Pad29
fields.evidence: Zeroed on creation (+0x29 dword, +0x2D word, +0x2F byte overlap).

fields.name: field_30
fields.evidence: Zeroed on creation; then the qword +0x30 is copied from the request.

fields.name: field_38
fields.evidence: ls::Guid::Guid() constructed at +0x38 on creation; copied as two qwords. Windows: bg3.exe+0x2F06990 generates a Guid into entry+0x38 when it is zero and passes it as the RequestId of esv::placement::SteeringRequestOneFrameComponent; compares it with the steering state's Guid.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: Windows esv::placement::ExecutionSystem bg3.exe+0x2F06990 walks this component's keys (+0x20, size +0x2C) and values (+0x30) with stride 0x78: entry+0x48 is set to 1 (started), compared with 1 and 2, and set to 3 at the end (line ~80 of the walk): a small state, not a bool (first version: bool).

fields.name: _Pad49
fields.evidence: Alignment of the 4-aligned transform at +0x4C; never written.

fields.name: ActorTransform
fields.evidence: Windows esv::placement::ExecutionSystem bg3.exe+0x2F06990 walks this component's keys (+0x20, size +0x2C) and values (+0x30) with stride 0x78: copies the 40 bytes of the actor's transform (FUN_140E5A590, 5 qwords) to entry+0x4C..+0x73 and sets the flag +0x74: storage of an optional ls::Transform (position, rotation quaternion, scale), left uninitialised while the flag is 0, so declared as plain floats. The first version (from the Toolkit) placed copied qwords at +0x50..+0x74.

fields.name: HasActorTransform
fields.evidence: Windows esv::placement::ExecutionSystem bg3.exe+0x2F06990 walks this component's keys (+0x20, size +0x2C) and values (+0x30) with stride 0x78: entry+0x74 set to 1 (if 0) when ActorTransform is stored; zeroed on creation.

fields.name: Placements
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2F07A00 allocates 0x40 and zeroes the HashMap shape (dwords +0x1C/+0x2C); destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870 frees the values at +0x30 then destroys the set part. ProcessPlacements and GatherValidationRequests read keys *(c+0x20), size *(c+0x2C) as entity handles and values *(c+0x30). Value stride 0x78 is taken from the local map built in ExecutionSystem::ProcessPlacementRequests (index*0x78) that is not proven to be moved into this component. Live: bucket table 5, one key/value per instance. Windows: bg3.exe+0x2F06990 reads keys at +0x20 (8 bytes each, count +0x2C) and values at +0x30 with stride 0x78.

open_questions: Meanings of entry +0x2C, +0x30 (copied qword) and of TargetKind values other than 1; names are inferred.
second_pass: Windows ExecutionSystem bg3.exe+0x2F06990 confirms the HashMap<EntityHandle, 0x78-byte entry> shape and corrects the entry's tail: +0x48 is a state byte (1..3), +0x4C an optional actor Transform with its flag at +0x74; +0 is a Transform-or-entity variant selected by +0x28 (declared raw).
